en: The image shows a black-and-white postcard with various scripts and languages displayed in a handwritten style. The scripts include Arabic, Cyrillic, Chinese, Devanagari, Latin, Greek, Japanese, Hebrew, and more, each seemingly rendering a similar phrase or word. Numbers and dates are also visible, and the visual focus is on the diversity of writing systems. There is no single image of a city or landmark, only text in many scripts.
